name: komdosh-dev-revealer
description: Retrieval before invention. /reveal surfaces what the project already decided — ADRs, specs, plans, decision comments, commit archaeology, and any RAG/MCP knowledge base wired up. /doc-reveal finds real documentation for a symbol or library, cheapest source first (in-repo KDoc, project docs, cache, MCP, canonical web docs, jar listings, decompilation last) and caches the result. Both cite their source and name the gaps instead of filling them; a gap is a result, an invented citation is the failure. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
